reason: Real OMW/CILI is safe but sparse/ambiguous for open concepts, structured composition remains evidence-only, stable-entity grounding covers a different class, and repeated source-only agents made generic Sem transport errors. Additional prompt-only changes are unlikely to solve both canonical protocol emission and multilingual open-concept grounding.
task: language-neutral semantic decomposition and constrained Lunum Sem emission, with unresolved concepts represented as explicit grounding proposals and abstention when provider evidence is insufficient
input: raw text plus source-language hint plus generated extraction contract
output: transport-valid candidate Sem, zero or more structured grounding proposals, or explicit abstention; no model-generated external ID is trusted
modelRole: proposal generator only; OpenLunum remains the validator, canonicalizer, identity authority, and safety gate

dataDesign.independentGroups: at least 5000, balanced across supported frames and open-concept categories
examples: named entities with pinned stable IDs
dataDesign.sources: licensed multilingual text plus independently authored semantic annotations; external WordNet/Wikidata IDs are evidence labels, not protocol definitions
dataDesign.splits: disjoint by semantic group, lexical family, named entity, and source template; a final protected split created only after implementation freeze

objectives: schema/frame constrained decoding or sequence loss
exact semantic identity agreement for equivalent groups
evaluation: critical-negative false equivalence with comparable denominator
expectedBenefit: Improved contract adherence and canonical open-concept decomposition; external-provider coverage alone cannot establish this benefit.
risks: training annotations becoming a hidden ontology
gate: Do not train until a concrete dataset/licensing budget and compute allocation are explicitly authorized; first implement a small offline pilot and compare against the frozen agent-native baseline.
